LanguageData.WBG_CommandLinkDesc: Share one list of work orders between the selected work stations. Any worker can then carry out any order at whichever station is free.\n\nStations can only be linked if they make the same things.
LanguageData.WBG_CommandUnlinkDesc: Remove this station from its group. It keeps its own, empty list of work orders; the group keeps the shared ones.
LanguageData.WBG_CommandSelectLinkedDesc: Select every station sharing this list of work orders.
LanguageData.WBG_CommandOrderingDesc:
Choose how this group works through its shared list of orders.

In order — the standard behaviour. The list is worked top-down, finishing the top order first.

Round robin — one item from each order in turn. Orders visibly move to the bottom of the list as they are worked, so the top of the list is always what happens next. Switching back to "in order" restores the arrangement you had.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseSelectTwo: Select at least two work stations to link.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseNotGroupable: {0} cannot be linked. Stations that build things over time, like mech gestators, keep their own work orders.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseDifferentMaps: Work stations must be on the same map to be linked.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseDifferentRecipes: {0} and {1} do not make the same things, so they cannot share work orders.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseUnshareableBill: "{0}" on {1} cannot be shared. Orders that tie themselves to one station, like mech gestation, must stay on it.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseAddUnshareableBill: "{0}" cannot be added to a shared list. Orders that tie themselves to one station, like mech gestation, must stay on it — unlink this one first.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseLinkFailed: Something went wrong linking these stations. Their work orders have been put back. See the log for details.
LanguageData.WBG_RefuseTooManyBills: These stations have {0} work orders between them, and a shared list holds at most {1}. Remove some first.
LanguageData.WBG_BillSharedTip: Shared with all {0} stations in this group.
LanguageData.WBG_BillPinnedTip: Only some stations in this group can make this. It will only be worked at the ones that can.
LanguageData.WBG_BillDoNextTip:
Do this next.

Moves this order to the top of the group's shared list, whichever ordering the group is using, and keeps it marked.

An order set to "do X times" unmarks itself once its count runs out. An order set to "do forever" stays marked until you unmark it, because it never finishes.

This makes an order first in line, not guaranteed. Workers still skip any order that is suspended, paused, or has no ingredients they can reach, and take the next one down instead. If nothing seems to happen after marking an order, that is why.
LanguageData.WBG_NbtDoNextNoSelectionTip: Select one order in the list below first; this marks the selected order.
LanguageData.WBG_NbtDoNextMultipleTip: Several orders are selected. Only one order per group can be marked, so select just the one you want.
LanguageData.WBG_NextOrderMarkedCompactTip: Marked as priority, and sitting at the top of the group's shared list.\n\nIt unmarks itself if the order is deleted, if a "do X times" count runs out, or if you drag another order above it. To unmark it yourself, select it and press "Unmark" above the list.
LanguageData.WBG_BillDoNextClearTip: Marked as priority, and sitting at the top of the group's shared list.\n\nClick to unmark it. It also unmarks itself if the order is deleted, if a "do X times" count runs out, or if you move another order above it. An order set to "do forever" stays marked until you unmark it.
LanguageData.WBG_SettingPreventOvershootTip: Stops a linked group overproducing when several workers start the same order at once. With this off, a group behaves like vanilla and can exceed "do X times".\n\nSide effect: an order being worked right now is drawn in the same colour vanilla uses for orders that cannot be started.
LanguageData.WBG_SettingIsolateMuteTip: When a station cannot find ingredients for an order, the game waits about ten seconds before trying again. Vanilla remembers that against the order, so in a linked group one badly-placed station makes every other station skip the order too. With this on, each station remembers its own.
LanguageData.WBG_SettingSelectWholeGroup: Select the whole group at once
LanguageData.WBG_SettingSelectWholeGroupTip:
Clicking any station in a group selects every station in it.

Off by default, for two reasons. The game shows no bill list for a multiple selection, so with this on you cannot open a station's work orders by clicking it. And buttons act on everything selected, so clicking one station and pressing Deconstruct will deconstruct the whole group.

The connecting line and the group outline are drawn either way.
LanguageData.WBG_SettingExcludedClassesTip: Advanced. Class names, separated by commas — for example: Building_WorkTable_HeatPush\n\nStations are normally chosen by what they make, which works for modded stations too. If a modded station misbehaves when linked, the error message names its class; put that name here and this mod will leave it alone. Takes effect after a restart.
